# Little CMS

This directory contains the MIT-licensed Little CMS 2.19.1 core required for embedded ICC profile validation and RGB-to-sRGB transforms.

- Release: `lcms2.19.1`
- Source: `https://github.com/mm2/Little-CMS/releases/download/lcms2.19.1/lcms2-2.19.1.tar.gz`
- SHA-256: `bfc54f7bab59fbc921012014a8032e4cba4abd46db47d46b76416a8c0b2815c8`
- Included files: `FILES`

Run `vendor/update.sh` to reproduce the vendored source. Utilities, tests, and GPL-licensed optional plugins are not included.
